steps.say: Click any empty point where the lines cross to place a stone. Stones never move once placed.
A stone with no empty point next to it is captured. Black's middle stone has one empty point left. Fill it.
steps.tip: Look at the black stone in the middle: which side is still open?

steps.say: Your stone in the middle is nearly surrounded. Save it by adding a stone next to it, giving it more room.
steps.tip: Only one point next to your stone is still empty.
